rationale: The only substantive delta is that the fixed implementation sets entry->seekable_stream=MagickTrue for every JPEG-related format entry. The Logic section does not mention seekable-stream support or any equivalent property. Its statements about version handling, conditional thread support, decoder/encoder setup, MIME type, and registration hold on both implementations. The statement about returning the size of the registered entry is imprecise relative to the returned coder signature, but it is equally unsupported by both versions and does not distinguish the vulnerable implementation from the fixed one.
